plugins.name: oxagen
plugins.description: Ontology layer for AI agents. Typed, queryable knowledge graph exposed to Claude Code as MCP-native tools — every code edit, research question, incident triage, or memory lookup gets grounded in deterministic graph context instead of guessing.

skills.name: oxagen-dogfooding
skills.description: Save findings to the Oxagen knowledge graph after every meaningful step. Use whenever you make a non-trivial decision, learn something new about the codebase, or finish a task — so the next agent (or the human) can find it via memory_search.
headings: Dogfooding skill — write to the KG as you work
Anti-slop rules (enforced by the no-slop quality gate)

skills.name: oxagen-tool-reference
skills.description: Full catalog of Oxagen MCP tools — code-graph (discovery, traversal, history, tests, CI), ontology typed-traversal, security, agent coordination, memory, and general-purpose. Load on demand from the using-oxagen gate skill when a specific tool surface is needed.
headings: Memory slash commands (for the user, not the agent)
Automatic capture — no explicit calls required

skills.name: using-oxagen
skills.description: Always-on routing policy for the Oxagen plugin. Use whenever the user asks a substantive question about the workspace, requests non-trivial changes to artifacts the workspace tracks (code, docs, runbooks, contracts, tickets, incidents), wants memory recall, or coordinates with other agents on the same workspace. Pairs with oxagen-tool-reference (full catalog) and oxagen-dogfooding (write-back).
headings: Using Oxagen — when to reach for the graph and memory
Rule 1 — Recall memory at the start of any non-trivial task
Rule 2 — Graph first before any non-trivial edit
Activation signals — fire on any of these
When the graph contradicts grep / your prior context

commands.name: alert
commands.description: Show full context for a security alert — description, affected nodes, recommended fix, and links to upstream advisories.

commands.name: ask
commands.description: Ask a natural-language question about the workspace ontology and get a direct answer backed by Cypher — faster than `/oxagen:search` for factual lookups.

commands.name: blame
commands.description: Enriched blame for a file — line-level authorship plus the PRs and issues that touched each block.

commands.name: callees
commands.description: List functions and methods that a symbol calls (its outgoing CALLS edges) ordered by PageRank.

commands.name: callers
commands.description: List callers of a function or method — direct callsites in the workspace ontology, ordered by PageRank.

commands.name: claim
commands.description: Claim a line range or symbol so other Oxagen-connected agents back off while you edit. Releases on completion or session end.

commands.name: cochange
commands.description: List symbols that historically change together with the target — derived from git commit co-occurrence in the workspace ontology.

commands.name: coverage
commands.description: Line-level coverage for a file — covered, uncovered, and partial lines from the latest CI run in the workspace ontology.

commands.name: describe
commands.description: Structural metadata for a symbol — kind, signature, decorators, docstring, and location — without the full behavioural breakdown that `/oxagen:explain` produces.

commands.name: expert
commands.description: Show the symbols and modules a person owns or has the deepest history in — inverse of `/oxagen:who-knows`.

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Generate a full behavioural description of a function — what it calls, reads, writes, throws, and returns — grounded in the workspace ontology.

commands.name: failing-tests
commands.description: List currently failing tests across the workspace — joined to commit, PR, and symbol nodes for quick triage.

commands.name: find-issues
commands.description: Search issues across the workspace by free-text — returns matching Linear / GitHub issues with state, labels, and linked PRs.

commands.name: find-pattern
commands.description: Search the workspace ontology for a code pattern — hybrid semantic + grep, returns file:line hits ranked by relevance.

commands.name: find-symbol
commands.description: Resolve a name to one or more symbols in the workspace ontology — fuzzy / structural lookup with file:line anchors.

commands.name: flaky-tests
commands.description: List tests with high pass / fail churn — flake-rate ranking sourced from the workspace ontology.

commands.name: forget
commands.description: Soft-delete a memory episode or procedure. Use when a stored memory is wrong or obsolete.

commands.name: go
commands.description: Dispatch the Oxagen agent swarm against Linear issues — sandboxed Claude Code sessions that open PRs and write back to the knowledge graph.

commands.name: impact
commands.description: Blast-radius report for a symbol — combines callers, dependencies, longest reach path, neighborhood, and active claims, ordered by PageRank.
headings: Direct callers (<N>, sorted by PageRank desc)

commands.name: incident
commands.description: Open, resolve, or link an incident on the workspace ontology — tracks production issues against the graph nodes they affect.
headings: `link` — associate a node with an open incident

commands.name: issue
commands.description: Show full issue context — title, body, comments, linked PRs, and affected graph nodes — from the workspace ontology.

commands.name: last-run
commands.description: Show the most-recent CI workflow run for a workflow / branch / PR — pulled from the workspace ontology.

commands.name: memory-enable
commands.description: Enable agent memory on the connected workspace — seeds 3 built-in metrics and activates automatic action capture, pattern detection, and nightly benchmarks.

commands.name: memory-logs
commands.description: View recent agent actions written to memory — see what your agent has been doing and how each action resolved.

commands.name: memory-metric
commands.description: Define a custom eval metric for your workspace — specify what "better" means for your agents and track improvement over time.

commands.name: module-tree
commands.description: Show the directory tree under a path with per-node symbol counts pulled from the workspace ontology.

commands.name: path
commands.description: Find the shortest call-graph path between two symbols. Wraps `code.find_path` (alias `code.dependency_path`).

commands.name: pr-history
commands.description: List the PRs that have touched a symbol — chronological history from the workspace ontology.

commands.name: pr
commands.description: Show the full PR context — title, body, commits, reviewers, files, and linked issues — joined to the workspace ontology.

commands.name: procedure-for
commands.description: Look up a memory procedure by exact trigger pattern — returns the recipe a past session promoted for this scenario.

commands.name: read
commands.description: Fetch the source bytes for a symbol — defined-range plus configurable surrounding context.

commands.name: recall
commands.description: Recall procedures and episodes the memory module has stored that match an intent — primary M8 retrieval call.

commands.name: recent
commands.description: List the most recent code changes in the workspace ontology — commits, files touched, and authors over a configurable window.

commands.name: refs
commands.description: Find every reference to a symbol — call sites, imports, type uses, and string mentions tied to the workspace ontology.

commands.name: remember
commands.description: Persist a free-form fact as a memory episode — anchored to the active agent session and optionally a symbol.

commands.name: repo-overview
commands.description: Summarize the workspace's repos — language mix, top packages, file count, and entry points pulled from the ontology.

commands.name: run-failures
commands.description: Show failed jobs and steps for a CI workflow run — with cold-log preview / pointer per failed step.
headings: /oxagen:run-failures — failed jobs and steps for a run

commands.name: search
commands.description: Natural-language search of the workspace ontology — runs NL→Cypher via `ontology.ask`, falls back to graph traversal, returns top hits with file:line.

commands.name: security-alerts
commands.description: List open security alerts for the workspace — Dependabot, CodeQL, and secret-scan findings with severity and affected nodes.

commands.name: setup
commands.description: End-to-end onboarding — opens the Oxagen setup wizard, parses the install string, writes settings, polls ingest, and verifies the MCP connection.

commands.name: tests-for
commands.description: List the tests that exercise a symbol — derived from the workspace ontology's TESTS edges.

commands.name: watch
commands.description: Start the Oxagen monitor supervisor (Linear backlog watcher in Phase 1).

commands.name: who-knows
commands.description: Identify the people most likely to know about a symbol — git history + review activity scored across the workspace ontology.
headings: /oxagen:who-knows — find the experts on a symbol

commands.name: workspace-select
commands.description: Select which Oxagen workspace this agent session should use — for MCP-only installs where multiple workspaces are available.

headings: From the Claude Code plugin marketplace (recommended)
Real-world use cases — beyond agentic coding
